description: This file defines the WebDriver class within the SuiteCRM testing framework, extending the Codeception WebDriver module. It includes methods for initializing window size and waiting for certain conditions during tests.

classes.name: WebDriver
classes.description: A test driver extending Codeception's WebDriver module, customized for SuiteCRM testing environment.

methods.name: initialWindowSize
methods.description: Sets the browser window size to default dimensions or configured values.

methods.name: _afterSuite
methods.description: Performs cleanup actions after the test suite, calling parent method.

methods.name: waitForElementVisible
methods.description: Waits until a webpage element is visible, or throws an exception.

methods.name: waitForElementNotVisible
methods.description: Waits until a webpage element is not visible, or throws an exception.

methods.name: waitForText
methods.description: Waits until specific text appears on the webpage within a timeout.
